{{Quote|That this latest crisis should revolve around the Nebula Front is especially ironic, since Valorum's father had an opportunity to eradicate the group, and he failed, chastising them rather than disbanding them.|Palpatine, speaking of the Dorvala Incident|<ref name="CoD" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of [[House Valorum/Legends|House Valorum]] worked as a [[Politics/Legends|politician]]. He supported a number of artistic works such as the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', and he failed in an opportunity to destroy the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group. The politician had a [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] named [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], who followed his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] career and became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
[[File:Valorum-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Finis Valorum followed his father in a political career.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the influential [[House Valorum/Legends|Valorum dynasty]] worked as a [[Politics/Legends|politician]]. At one point in his career, he dealt with a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization called the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] and had an opportunity to destroy the group. Instead, he only chastised them, and they continued to function throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CoD" /> The politician had a partner, and together they underwrote a number of major artistic works, including an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] titled ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]''. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the two had a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] named [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="FF56">{{FactFile|56|VAL 1-4|Finis Valorum}}</ref>

The young Valorum was presumed by observers to follow in his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] political career, and as such his election as [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="FF56" /> of the [[Lytton sector/Legends|Lytton sector]]<ref name="Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was unsurprising and was aided by familial and political connections. Valorum later became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FF56" /> During his second term<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Valorum faced crisis in the fallout of the [[Dorvalla Incident]], an attack perpetrated by the Nebula Front. Shortly afterward, he attended a performance of ''The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths'' at the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]], considered a fitting touch given his parents' patronage of it. Before the performance began, Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] discussed the Dorvala Incident with several other senators, believing it ironic that Valorum was affected by an event caused by the inaction of his father.<ref name="CoD" />

==Personality and traits==
Finis Valorum's father served as a politician, and his connections allowed his son to rise to senatorial office. When dealing with the Nebula Front, he chose to chastise them rather than eliminate them.<ref name="CoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Finis Valorum's father was first mentioned in ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', a [[2001]] novel by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="CoD" />
